eoNote: Emergency orders (EOs) can open, close or change any of these rules at any time. Check current ADF&G regulations and emergency orders before fishing.
general: Fishing open year-round for all species unless noted (Kodiak fresh water, p. 24).
Road Zone = fresh waters east of a line south from Crag Point (Anton Larsen Bay) to the westernmost point of Saltery Cove, incl. Woody & Long islands (p. 24).
Road Zone fresh water: rainbow/steelhead catch-and-release only except stocked lakes (p. 24).
Nov 1–Apr 30: only unbaited artificial lures or flies in Road Zone fresh waters (not stocked lakes, Chiniak & Barry lagoons). p. 24
Kalsin Pond outlet stream, Chiniak Hwy culvert to ADF&G marker ~150 ft downstream: closed year-round (p. 25).
Island Lake Creek: closed year-round to all salmon fishing (p. 25).
